name: Aviation Security Act
text: Locked cockpit doors, watch lists at check-in, federal screeners. Dull and expensive, until it is not.

name: Medicare Drug Benefit
text: Prescription coverage for every senior, through Medicare.

name: Across-the-Board Tax Cut
text: Cut every bracket; return the surplus to the people who paid it.

name: Broadband for Every County
text: Federal loans to wire rural America.

name: Standards and Testing Act
text: Test every child; fund the schools that improve.

name: National Energy Plan
text: New transmission lines, a strategic power reserve and help for California.

name: Patients' Bill of Rights
text: The right to see a specialist, and to sue your health plan.
